cameras.name: S1_sunset_lane
cameras.must_show: from a car's roof at the 330 lane's mouth (r 199, 3 m inside the ring's faces) aimed at the lake: hearth_stone_25 at the frame's left edge, the track, the lake shelf, the whole lake with its centre 294 deg from the eye = under the measured sun, the outlet notch and backdrop peaks; >= 60 % of the water surface visible by ray test (terrain_summary); no solid between the eye and any part of the water (R6)

cameras.name: S2_trailhead_to_pan
cameras.must_show: from the trail at m 14: the skillet bedded in coals, ember crust, scorch decals, the S/E stone clusters, the handle end-on, the pan wall and rim plate in golden light; the sign and cairn at the frame edges

cameras.name: S3_crest_to_basin
cameras.must_show: from the pan crest at 330: glacis, hearth slab, ash bed, the 330 lane between hearth_stone_25 and _00 with the chocks behind, the meadow, the forest climbing the NW wall to the rounded crest, cloud layer, three haze steps

cameras.name: S4_driver_ash_band
cameras.must_show: driver's eye on the ash band: ember plates 2-10 m, sparks/glow particles, hearth_stone_09 (36 m) at 30 m with 4K-class texel density, ash-drift decals

cameras.name: S5_lantern_night
cameras.must_show: night: the lantern spot pool on the meadow, the tripod poles, log_north's east-end kindling fire beside the tripod (24 m from its nearest foot) and its light on the N cluster's outer faces, 30+ night lights on; the sky is whatever core_celestial renders for the record's date/lat at clock 0.50 (sun -19.7 deg; its moon/star field is unmeasured and its enableChrome overrides the ScatterSky's authored night keys - B0 r3), so the sky is recorded, not a pass criterion

cameras.name: S6_handle_night
cameras.must_show: night from the handle deck across the pan: the ember ring glowing beyond the crest, the two north kindling fires seen through the N cluster's gaps (16.5 and 32.5 deg from the camera, between stones 02/03 and 03/04; margins in checks R11), heat wisps, rim plate lit by ember lights; the sky as core_celestial renders it (recorded, not a pass criterion)

cameras.name: S7_forest_floor
cameras.must_show: forest interior: needle litter, ferns, deadfall clusters, bark 2-20 m, sub-surface backlit twig cards, 3 LODs visible at 20/60/150 m

cameras.name: S8_trail_switchback
cameras.must_show: trail m 520: the decal stack (surface/flows/gravel/tiretracks/edge/cracks/puddles/dust), split-rail fence, scree, the whole hearth below with the forest as imposters

cameras.name: S9_lakeshore
cameras.must_show: shore pebbles/sand, reeds, water ripple + foam, sky reflection, the WNW outlet notch

cameras.name: S10_ridge_crest
cameras.must_show: from 6 m inside the crest at bearing 40 (in front of it, inside the basin): the whole basin, skillet, hearth, four lanes, track ring, lake, forest zones, backdrop ring; the far-field test frame

cameras.name: AERIAL_300m
cameras.must_show: straight down: pan, hearth slab, ash bed, 20 stones + 8 chocks, four lanes, track, logs, tripod, pot
